newsitem.title: USA: Cuomo says will announce U.S. housing dept revamp.
newsitem.headline: Cuomo says will announce U.S. housing dept revamp.

text.p: Secretary of Housing and Urban Development Andrew Cuomo said Monday he would announce a revamp of his department on Thursday, but gave no details.
"We will announce a total overhaul of HUD later this week," Cuomo told reporters during a briefing on steps announced by President Clinton to encourage inner city home ownership.

Cuomo described the department, which administers the federal government's housing and urban programs, as a typical "top-down bureaucracy" and said one aim of the reorganization would be to push decision-making to communities.
